title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:

After Tom ignores Talking Ben's warning about touching the science equipment, he accidentally opens a wormhole to a parallel universe; on the other side he meets alternate versions of all his friends - including a Talking Angela with a crush on him.

A monster attacks during a grand opening; a celebrity comes to town.

Venice is under siege; Kooky Von Koopa makes a magic pendant.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E13 — The Moblins Are Revolting
Ganon demonstrates a new wand that makes a bubble around its victim that can only be popped by the Triforce of Power; fed up with Ganon's orders, a Moblin uses the wand to trap Ganon in a bubble and throws him down a bottomless pit.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E1 — The Ringer
Link's only consolation for the boring duty of guarding the Triforce of Wisdom is keeping company with Princess Zelda, who does not feel the same way.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E2 — Cold Spells
The first days of spring mark spring-cleaning at Hyrule Castle; Link fakes a cold to avoid chores; Ganon infiltrates the castle and, to create a distraction, covertly augments Sprite's magical powers as she too performs cleaning chores.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S1 E2 — The Adventure Begins Part II
PacWorld is under siege by ghosts and there are no more fresh berries from the Tree of Life; Pac strikes a deal with four ghosts, Inky, Blinky, Pinky and Clyde, to lead him into the Netherworld to try and find the tree and save PacWorld.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S1 E3 — No Pets Allowed... Especially Monsters Part I
After Pac and his friends defeat all the ghosts, Betrayus clones an army of Netherworld monsters.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S1 E4 — No Pets Allowed... Especially Monsters Part II
Dr. Buttocks invents the Molecular Magnifier to create gigantic monsters.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:

Skeletor tries to banish Evil-Lyn to another dimension for betraying him in favor of the Snake Men.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:

He-Man desperately tries to stop King Hiss from using a devastatingly powerful ancient artifact that will grant him immense power.
